reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin that automatically classifies task modes and routes requests to different DeepSeek models, making orchestration the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 根据任务类型自动在配置的 DeepSeek 模型之间切换，并尊重手动模型选择。
summaries.en: Automatically switches between configured DeepSeek models based on task type while respecting manual model selections.

capabilities: Classifies task types using rule-based keywords and phase signals
Routes requests between configured DeepSeek models based on the detected task mode
Preserves explicit model selections and records model-switch events
